answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.784, matching system-prompted (0.79-0.82) and far from quantized (10-17) or fine-tuned (5.5-8). Logit changes are large (KL 0.395, top-1 agreement 0.852, DiFR 0.691), slightly beyond the system-prompted range but in the same direction. Activations also fit: onset layer 8, relative L2 plateau of 0.487 at layer 16 and 0.515 at layer 32, cosine 0.840, effective rank 2.84, size ratio 0.973, activation-to-logit ratio 1.3, raw-score shift/TV 3.3. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the 31.7-64.0 expected for system-prompted, and that is the main reason for doubt. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the first-token divergence and the large, plateauing activation difference; quantized by the large logit and activation shifts.
